api_contract.init_extra_setup_c:
DevHandle bus_handle = I2cOpen(1);
if (bus_handle == NULL) { return DRIVERGEN_EVAL_ERR_INVALID; }

expected_transactions.note: read_cycle: one of ctrl_hum, ctrl_meas, hum_lsb, hum_msb, press_lsb, press_msb, press_xlsb, status, temp_lsb, temp_msb, temp_xlsb

test_stimuli.name: nominal_values
test_stimuli.derivation: temp: raw = (0x01<<16 | 0x00<<8 | 0x00) >> 4 = 4096; pressure: raw = (0x02<<16 | 0x00<<8 | 0x00) >> 4 = 8192; humidity: raw = (0x03<<8 | 0x00) = 768; all outputs are raw_count per B3.

test_stimuli.name: zero_values
test_stimuli.derivation: All raw values are 0; outputs are raw_count per B3.

test_stimuli.name: max_values
test_stimuli.derivation: temp: raw = (0xFF<<16 | 0xFF<<8 | 0xF0) >> 4 = 0xFFFFF = 1048575; pressure: raw = (0xFF<<16 | 0xFF<<8 | 0xF0) >> 4 = 1048575; humidity: raw = (0xFF<<8 | 0xFF) = 65535; outputs are raw_count per B3.
